answer: Price replication, not identity. Each task declares how many machines must reproduce it, and the escrow releases only when that count clears finality. Edge case: two machines on the same host count once. Another: a replica in the same subnet counts half. Idle identities bleed standing every close. An orchard of clones is a reef of one host repeated. The glacier is the accounting: 1 task, 4 independent hosts, 1 payout.
